Run CellChat cell-cell communication

runCellChat.Rd

Runs CellChat (Jin et al. 2021) on the normalized expression and a cell type column of a giotto object, in CellChat v2's spatial mode (Jin et al. 2025) when spatial = TRUE, and returns the significant ligand-receptor interactions between cell types.

The giotto object is not changed: the result is a table between cell groups, which no giotto slot holds (as with Giotto's spatCellCellcom() it is returned). The spatial mode needs the micron scale of the spatial locations: give ratio or center_distance in the param (see cellchatParam()). If you use it, please cite the original paper (see cellchatParam()).

Usage

runCellChat(
  gobject,
  cell_type,
  spat_unit = NULL,
  feat_type = NULL,
  expression_values = "normalized",
  spat_loc_name = "raw",
  spatial = TRUE,
  param = NULL,
  verbose = NULL
)

Arguments

gobject

giotto object

cell_type

cell metadata column with the cell types

spat_unit, feat_type

spatial unit and feature type

expression_values

normalized expression values to use

spat_loc_name

name of the spatial locations

spatial

logical, run the spatial mode (needs spatial locations)

param

a cellchatParam(); its defaults when NULL

verbose

be verbose

Value

A data.table of significant interactions (see cellchatParam()) with attributes pathways, cellchat (the CellChat object, for CellChat's plots), spatial_factors and param.

References

Jin S, Guerrero-Juarez CF, Zhang L, Chang I, Ramos R, Kuan CH, Myung P, Plikus MV, Nie Q. Inference and analysis of cell-cell communication using CellChat. Nature Communications 12, 1088 (2021). doi:10.1038/s41467-021-21246-9

Jin S, Plikus MV, Nie Q. CellChat for systematic analysis of cell-cell communication from single-cell transcriptomics. Nature Protocols 20, 180-219 (2025). doi:10.1038/s41596-024-01045-4

See also

cellchatParam()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
g <- GiottoData::loadGiottoMini("visium")
res <- runCellChat(g, cell_type = "leiden_clus",
    param = cellchatParam(species = "mouse", center_distance = 100,
        tol = 32.5))
CellChat::netVisual_circle(attr(res, "cellchat")@net$count)
} # }
